children: U.S. GOLD CORP. reported first-quarter fiscal 2027 results for the three months ended July 31, 2026, recording no revenue as a development‑stage company and a net loss of $(4.60M), or diluted EPS of $(0.28), versus a net loss of $(2.08M) and EPS of $(0.15) in the year‑ago quarter.
Revenue was $0 for Q1 FY2027, unchanged from the year‑ago quarter (development‑stage company; no revenues recognized).
Net income (loss) was $(4.60M) for Q1 FY2027, compared with $(2.08M) in the prior‑year quarter (loss widened YoY).
Diluted EPS was $(0.28) for Q1 FY2027, versus $(0.15) in the year‑ago quarter.
Feasibility study completed for the CK Gold project, showing an NPV of $632M and an initial 11‑year mine life with 1.6M gold equivalent ounces of reserves.
Permitting progress included securing an Industrial Siting Permit, extended through December 2027; however, construction remains paused pending demonstration of substantial external financing.
Exploration efforts continue with a developing drill program at CK Gold to expand mineralization and follow up magnetic anomalies.
Operational spending shifted toward project‑related consulting, permitting and director/consulting stock‑based compensation, contributing to higher operating expenses during the quarter.
Company states it has sufficient cash for near‑term permitting and engineering activities but that full project construction is contingent on securing significant external financing.
